title: Back an Express API with SQLite
description: Kilnworth Pottery's workshop API keeps everything in memory, so every restart throws away the week's changes, and places are still booked on a paper sheet. Move the API you built onto SQLite, which is built into Node, one issue at a time: a database file and a table, reads and writes as queries, bookings in a second table with the places left counted by the database, and group bookings that go in all at once or not at all. You learn to use a real database from code, with every value passed as a value and never written into the SQL.
